findings_to_judge.finding: Rezolve has issued no new shares since the January 2026 raise (398.83m shares outstanding today = 336,327,587 at 31 Dec 2025 + the 62,500,000 sold at $4.00 on 21 Jan 2026, to the share), which lets H1 cash be bounded from the outside: $111.1m at 31 Dec 2025 + $250m gross January proceeds - $230m paid all-cash for Reward Loyalty on 10 Feb 2026 = at most ~$131m before H1 operating burn (FY2025 adjusted EBITDA was -$59m) and before the ~$102m Crownpeak/Monroe term loan that matures 31 Dec 2026 - so only a small single-digit-percent fraction of the $300m repurchase mandate is actually fundable, and the H1 balance sheet is where that arithmetic first becomes public.

The UK statutory accounts of Rezolve AI PLC (company 14573691) for the year ended 31 December 2025 were due at Companies House by 30 June 2026 and are still not filed as of 31 August 2026 - the register shows the last accounts on file as the period ending 31 December 2024 and flags accounts overdue - even though the company published an 'Annual Report and Accounts 2025' as Exhibit 99.2 to a 6-K on 30 March 2026, and its shareholders only passed the resolution covering auditor appointment on a resolution filed 22 July 2026, three weeks after the statutory deadline.

Rezolve AI PLC - the listed parent itself, not a US subsidiary - registered a charge in favour of Monroe Capital Management Advisors LLC created 22 December 2025 and still outstanding, plus a second outstanding charge in favour of Crownpeak Technology Holdings LLC created 19 January 2026, meaning the ~$102m of Crownpeak term loans maturing 31 December 2026 (Term SOFR + 5.50%) are secured at the top of the group; the $300m buyback in turn requires a UK court-sanctioned capital reduction, expected mid-September, in which secured creditors get a formal creditor-protection say.

Rezolve took a $63.3m impairment in FY2025 on its SQD (Subsquid) token holdings and told investors continued volatility could force further impairments; SQD traded around a $0.0627 low in January 2026 and was capped by a $0.056-$0.058 resistance zone by June 2026, so the H1 2026 accounts most likely carry another digital-asset writedown into a net loss line the market has no estimate for, because only the revenue line was pre-announced.

Reward Loyalty UK Limited (CH 10701520), the business Rezolve bought for $239,557,869 cash on 2026-02-10 and told US investors would add 'approximately $90 million of EBITDA-accretive revenue', filed audited group accounts at Companies House on 2026-07-25 for its year ended 30 April 2025 showing turnover of GBP 52.89m (approx $67-71m) and gross profit of about GBP 21m - i.e. a ~40% gross-margin business generating roughly GBP 2m EBITDA on 186-209 employees, not a 90%-margin software asset. [snippet_only: the 74-page PDF is behind an S3 redirect WebFetch cannot follow; figures are from two independent CH aggregators reading the same filing]

Rezolve's consolidated gross margin has already fallen from the 95.8% it reported for H1 2025 to 66.0% for audited FY2025 (revenue $46,800,099 less cost of revenue $15,922,202 per the 20-F income statement), which implies roughly 61% in H2 2025 - and H1 2026 is the FIRST period that consolidates Reward at all, on top of Crownpeak (from 1 Dec 2025) and GroupBy. The 1 September interims are the first gross-margin disclosure the market will see since the 95.8% print.

Both of Rezolve AI PLC's registered charges are still shown as OUTSTANDING at Companies House - Monroe Capital Management Advisors LLC (charge created 2025-12-22) and Crownpeak Technology Holdings LLC (created 2026-01-19) - covering the $101,540,086 Monroe borrowing that the 20-F classified as SHORT-TERM debt at 31 Dec 2025 and the $50,000,000 Crownpeak promissory notes, while no 6-K filed in 2026 announces any refinancing, and the 20-F's going-concern mitigation depended explicitly on 'refinancing short-term debt'. Cash arithmetic: $111,112,251 at 31 Dec 2025, plus the ~$250m registered direct raise closed 2026-01-21 (62.5m shares at $4, ~5% placement fee), less the $239,557,869 cash paid for Reward on 2026-02-10, leaves roughly $110m before any H1 operating burn (FY2025 operating burn was $63,147,255 on a far smaller cost base). The 1 September interims are the first balance sheet since 31 Dec 2025.

The entire +16.8% five-day run-up in the baseline is one company-issued press release: 'Google Selects Rezolve Ai's Proprietary Distributed Database Platform' on 2026-08-25, which moved the stock ~19% in a session (close 2.43 on 08-24, pre-market 2.645 on 08-25) and which discloses no contract value, no term, no revenue and no Google quote or spokesperson; Google's own Blockchain Analytics / Web3 documentation and partner blogs name Subsquid and Chainstack for exactly this function and do not mention Rezolve; and Rezolve did not furnish the release on a Form 6-K, its last 6-K being 2026-08-06.

The reaffirmed ~$360m FY2026 guide requires H2 2026 revenue of ~$233m against ~$127m in H1, +83% half-on-half, at a point where the acquired run-rates are largely already in the base: Reward at GBP 52.89m/yr (~$67-71m), Crownpeak at ~$70m/yr for an $81.0m purchase price, GroupBy at ~$30m/yr - about $84m per half combined - leaving roughly $149m of H2 from everything else versus roughly $43m in H1.
